This morning I tested positive for COVID-19.

Thankfully I only have mild symptoms because I have been vaccinated and received my booster.

Everyone should be vaccinated and boosted as soon as they’re able. It’s the best way to protect yourself and your loved ones.

A record 14M+ people have selected plans for 2022 ACA health coverage since November 1, 2021!

The Biden administration extended the Open Enrollment Period through Jan. 15, so if you still need of 2022 health insurance, you have 1 MORE DAY to enroll: https://t.co/JJLHCTOhXq

The decision in Roe v Wade was one of the most significant advances in healthcare for women.

Unfortunately, the freedom to choose is in more danger now than any time since 1973. We must continue doing everything we can to protect this basic right. https://t.co/Z8NXzUWkVz
Thank you @HumeFoggKnights for dropping off letters in support of the Childhood Nutrition Reauthorization Act! https://t.co/qmtu2bW3mk

This Texas-style abortion ban bill backed by Republicans in the TN General Assembly allowing people to collect bounties by turning in people who help women access abortion will threaten the lives and health of countless people across the state. 

https://t.co/7hI5OK9LSi

Tonight, the House passed the omnibus spending package, which includes funding for local projects. I'm happy funding for these projects was finally approved as they are vital to making Nashville more inclusive and grow our community more equitably.

https://t.co/f7YXoMYS0f

For more than a decade, states like Tennessee have been turning down billions of dollars from the federal government to expand Medicaid and save rural hospitals.
https://t.co/zSWqODUF44
Instead of doing everything they can to help, our state legislature consistently chooses politics over people. States that expand Medicaid have fewer rural hospital closures and fewer deaths.

Today marks 12 years since the Affordable Care Act was signed into law. This was one of the most important votes I have ever taken. I was proud to support this bill and expand health coverage to millions more Americans. #ACAHereToStay

Take time today to read this piece on the harm that anti-trans legislation inflicts on the LGBTQ community, especially our youth. 

We should be working to foster communities where every child can thrive. #TDOV https://t.co/GxEBzM6A5i

Because of @POTUS' Executive Order to strengthen the #AffordableCareAct, nearly one million Americans will see lower premiums for their health insurance & hundreds of thousands of uninsured Americans will gain affordable coverage. I was proud to vote for the #ACA. #ProtectOurCare

If this opinion becomes final, America will see an unprecedented rollback of a constitutional right.

We cannot let the war against reproductive health prevail.

Our fears were realized with this attack on women and the rights of all Americans. Now, abortion is effectively banned in Tennessee and more than a dozen other states. This compromises the health and safety of those seeking necessary reproductive healthcare. https://t.co/FowpiEHoxA

The Biden Administration did the right thing by listening to the concerns that Tennesseans raised during the public comment period. As I’ve been saying all along, Tennessee needs to go back to the drawing board. https://t.co/K45Fci8eNw

The capped funding, closed drug formulary, and unregulated use of so-called “shared savings” should never have been approved. 

If Tennessee really wants to put the health of Tennesseans first, they should have expanded Medicaid. Now is the time to get it done.

The #InflationReductionAct reduces health insurance premiums so families can afford to buy it, stops the rampant drug company rip-offs, lowers heating and cooling costs, and makes massive investments in domestic energy production to create jobs and save our planet.

After far too long, relief is finally here to help Tennesseans who have been paying way too much for healthcare, prescription drugs, & energy prices. Democrats promised to help Middle TN families and we’ve been delivering on that promise for many months.

https://t.co/FTbFfGVHGL

September is National #RecoveryMonth.

If you are facing substance use or mental health challenges, treatment is available and recovery is possible.

💻Find help today: https://t.co/M78nHx2wJM

Check out great coverage by local journalists like @NC5_JKraus

Many of you know that my late wife, Martha, died peacefully under great care of @AliveHospice after her Alzheimers. 5,000 Middle TNs like my family get help from them every year.

2/
https://t.co/SBPh3v3C9S

It's the only non-profit option here in Middle TN!  If we lose @AliveHospice for-profit pirates who brag that they only spend 54 cents of every Medicare dollar on patients will be at our bedside.

Another great piece by @scavendish 

3/

https://t.co/5GmNfG6uFm

Spread the word among your networks. The board of @AliveHospice is selling out to out-of-state money grubbers.

Here's another great story by @FrankGluck 

5/

https://t.co/CVABLnpGAB

Running hospice is hard, but needed.  Running a foundation is easy by comparison. Caring for patients v writing checks. @AliveHospice is worth $50-100 million today. Current leadership is selling out, betraying us, for 30 pieces of silver.

10/

The board tells us not to worry. 70%+ of the hospice industry is for-profit. Don't be seduced. We won't be able to get @AliveHospice back. Medical journals prove for-profit care is for the almightly dollar instead of patients. 

https://t.co/7XqB5rF0i0

11/

And this! @AliveHospice isn't even selling to company they vetted. @AmedisysInc is already being merged into a larger out-of-state corp, Option Health. HQ is moving from Baton Rouge to Chicago in a $3.6 billion merger. Alive is 0.006% of that deal. Nothing to them. 

12/

I'm not against for-profit businesses. They pay taxes that paid my salary in Congress for years. But for-profits must help their customer patients. For-profit hospice doesn't have to because Medicare pays them $200/day for doing zero. Bad companies abuse a bad system. 

13/
